name: [🌎] Mine a Planet
desc:
⛏️ Command a FLEET of laser drones to blast apart a giant voxel PLANET — and get RICH!
Idle the cash in, evolve your world, and chase 1-in-25-TRILLION rarity drones. 🪐💥

💰 IDLE TYCOON — your drone swarm auto-mines 24/7; cash climbs into the BILLIONS
🌍 MINE A WHOLE PLANET — ore bursts off in tiers, from Azurite to Aurum and beyond
✨ EVOLVE YOUR PLANET — cinematic upgrades unlock rarer ore and bigger worlds
🎰 FREE UNLIMITED ROLLS — boost your Luck and pull god-tier drones
📈 UPGRADE your fleet — speed, cargo & mining power to mine faster
